TextContext.SourceString: 时间正好，今夜星汉璀璨，正适合我们品茶尝饼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The stars are out and shining - what a perfect time to enjoy some tea and biscuits.

TextContext.SourceString: 这浓郁的麦香和香浓的馅料，正是对这个节日最好的诠释，你觉得呢，引航者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The rich aroma of pastry and the fragrant smell of fillings are the perfect accompaniment to these celebrations, don't you agree?

TextContext.SourceString: 我已经很久没有和朋友私下里这样度过这样一个有意义的节日了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's been a long time since I've celebrated such a meaningful day with a friend.

TextContext.SourceString: 我曾经一度失去了对未来的期待，但现在我感觉有所不同了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There was a time when I had completely lost hope for the future, but things are different now.

TextContext.SourceString: 我不禁有些期待未来的日子了，吃下这块饼，感觉身心都得到了满足，呵呵。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now, I can't help but look forward to what tomorrow will bring. Mmm... with this biscuit, I feel like my mood's improved, too!

TextContext.SourceString: 来年要是有机会，我希望我们能再度相约，享受这丰收和睦的节日。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If the opportunity arises next year, I hope we can enjoy a peaceful celebration together once more.

TextContext.SourceString: （繁忙的工作日下午，刚刚送走了接待名单上的最后一位预约病人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It's been a busy afternoon, but we finally managed to clear the last patient.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，今天的最后一位病人接待完后，就没有更多预约了。今天的工作比昨天结束得要早呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, that was the last patient. We don't have any more appointments today. We can clock out early!

TextContext.SourceString: 不过……你今天也要去忙庆典筹备的事情吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But... will you also be busy with the festival preparations today?

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊。星绘好像也在帮忙？
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's right. Aren't you helping out too?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯。不过和前辈负责的是不同的模块，好可惜我们不能一起……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mhm. It's a shame we're in charge of different things. I was looking forward to working together...

TextContext.SourceString: 等庆典筹备结束后，应该会有一场盛大的烟花庆典。到时候，前辈可以和我一起去看吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Once the festival preparations are done, there should be a huge fireworks celebration. Why don't we watch it together?

TextContext.SourceString: 总觉得，最近和前辈在一起的时间少了许多。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I feel like we haven't been able to spend much time together lately.

TextContext.SourceString: 当然可以！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sounds good!

TextContext.SourceString: 肯定要和星绘一起看啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Absolutely, I'd love to watch it with you!

TextContext.SourceString: 好。那在之前的每一天，我都会认真进行筹备工作的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Great. In that case, I'll make sure to give the preparations my all!

TextParam.SourceString: 在期盼之中，烟花庆典之日终于到来了。
TextParam.LocalizedString: The day of the much-anticipated fireworks festival has finally arrived.

TextContext.SourceString: 再次确认过，没有候诊病患，没有预约名单，所有相关任务都处理完成。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've gone down the checklist. There aren't any pending patients or appointments. We're all set here.

TextContext.SourceString: 那么前辈，就在今天了——
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, today is the day—

TextContext.SourceString: 就在今天——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Today is the day!

TextContext.SourceString: 烟花庆典日！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The fireworks festival!

TextContext.SourceString: 烟花庆典日！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The fireworks festival!

TextContext.SourceString: 真的期待了很久，和前辈一起看烟花的日子……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've been looking forward to this for so long...

TextContext.SourceString: 走，我们去找一个最好的位置！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's go find the perfect spot!

TextContext.SourceString: 烟花……很美。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The fireworks... they're so beautiful.

TextContext.SourceString: 他们说，每一束烟花，都是降落人间的一颗星星……
TextContext.LocalizedString: They say that fireworks are like shooting stars...

TextContext.SourceString: 那星绘，就是降落在我身边的那一颗哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If that's the case, you're the shooting star that landed right next to me.

TextContext.SourceString: 诶……原来我的秘密，已经被前辈发现了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh... so you've discovered my secret already?

TextContext.SourceString: 那以后的日子，星星也会一直陪伴在你身边的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In the days to come, this star will always be by your side.

TextParam.SourceString: 尽管不舍，烟花表演结束后，夜空重新沉寂了下来。
TextParam.LocalizedString: Though everyone was reluctant to leave, once the fireworks display ended, the night sky slowly became silent once more.

TextContext.SourceString: 烟花都放完，庆典是不是就落幕了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now that the fireworks are over, does that mean the festival is too?

TextContext.SourceString: 有点不舍得就这样结束……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I kind of don't want it to end...

TextContext.SourceString: 只是今天的庆典结束了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's only the end of the festival for today.

TextContext.SourceString: 之后的日子里还会有的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There will be more days like this to come.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯！那在没有庆典的时候，我可以偶尔和前辈来这里看星星吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm... Even when there aren't any celebrations, could we come by every now and then to watch the stars together?

TextContext.SourceString: 或者，不看星星、不看任何东西也可以。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Actually... we don't have to watch the stars or anything else at all...

TextContext.SourceString: 只要是和前辈一起……
TextContext.LocalizedString: As long as you're by my side...

TextContext.SourceString: 这样的时光于我而言，就和庆典无异。
TextContext.LocalizedString: For me, that's as good as any celebration.

TextContext.SourceString: （郑重地答应了星绘，暗下决心，以后一定要多陪陪她。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I promised Celestia I’d spend more time with her and made a silent vow to do so.)

TextContext.SourceString: 谢谢你送我回来，前辈。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thanks for walking me home, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 时间不早了，你早点休息，我们明天星庇所见。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's getting late, so make sure to get some rest. I'll see you at Astral Sanctuary tomorrow.

TextContext.SourceString: 好，你也早点休息。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright. Try not to stay up too late yourself.

TextContext.SourceString: 那我先走了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll get going then.

TextContext.SourceString: 对了……前辈！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, wait... Navigator!

TextContext.SourceString: 回到住所后，记得看一下邮箱。
TextContext.LocalizedString: When you get back, don't forget to check your mailbox.

TextContext.SourceString: “和前辈共度时光”……这样的沐春礼物，我很喜欢。我为前辈准备的沐春礼物，希望你也喜欢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I really enjoyed spending time with you. It felt like the perfect Spring Blessings gift. I've prepared something for you too. I hope you'll like it.

TextContext.SourceString: （在繁忙的庆典筹备工作中，收到了奥黛丽的短信。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (During the busy festival preparations, I suddenly received a text from Audrey.)

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然前面铺垫了一大堆，但最后结尾收束在——“你能来一趟吗”？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After a long preamble, it all boiled down to—"Can you drop by?")

TextContext.SourceString: （于是，下班后依约来到了奥黛丽的家中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (So, after work, I find myself at Audrey's place as promised.)

TextContext.SourceString: 一如既往地准时呢，引航者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Punctual as always, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 格罗夫集团正在进行年终盘点，所以我没怎么参与庆典的筹备，但最近身边的人都在谈论这个话题，我很好奇你的看法……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Grove Enterprises has been doing its year-end audits, so I've been too busy to help with the preparations. That said, the topic keeps coming up, so I was curious about your thoughts...

TextContext.SourceString: 我可是庆典特邀嘉宾哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm a VIP guest at the festival, you know!

TextContext.SourceString: 这种筹备工作，怎么少得了我~
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm a key part of the preparation efforts!

TextContext.SourceString: 果然，和我的猜测一样，你应该已经参与了，并且乐在其中。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just as I thought, you're really enjoying it.

TextContext.SourceString: 你是真的对庆典感兴趣，还是，只是享受这种帮助别人的感觉呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But tell me, are you genuinely into festivals, or is it the satisfaction of helping out that appeals to you...?

TextContext.SourceString: 话说回来，格罗夫集团赞助了这次烟花庆典。按以往，他们都会给我留几张最前排的票。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Speaking of which, Grove Enterprises is sponsoring the fireworks show. They usually save me a few front-row seats.

TextContext.SourceString: 如果你那天有空的话……或许，我们可以一起去看……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you're free that day... maybe we could watch the fireworks together...

TextContext.SourceString: 当然可以。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course, I’d be happy to join you.

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽看到烟花的表情，我可不能错过。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I wouldn't miss the expression on your face for anything in the world.

TextContext.SourceString: 你能应约，我很开心。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Great, it's settled then.

TextContext.SourceString: 什、什么啊！还能露出什么表情！
TextContext.LocalizedString: W-What are you talking about? What expression...?!

TextContext.SourceString: 我倒是开始好奇了，烟花庆典……是多么特别的东西吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I’m starting to wonder, are fireworks really that special?

TextContext.SourceString: 在真正看到之前，我会充满期待的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll be looking forward to seeing it for myself.

TextContext.SourceString: （就这样，和奥黛丽定下了关于“一起看烟花”的约定。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (And just like that, we made plans to watch the fireworks together.)

TextParam.SourceString: 在期盼之中，烟花庆典之日终于到来了。
TextParam.LocalizedString: The day of the much-anticipated fireworks festival has finally arrived.

TextContext.SourceString: 已经准备好了？那我们出发吧，司机已经在楼下等着了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: All set? Let's get going; the driver’s already waiting downstairs.

TextContext.SourceString: 不用司机，要带我去另外的地方？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait, no driver? Are you taking me somewhere else?

TextContext.SourceString: 好吧，如果真如你所说，能看到足够特殊的美景的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright, if the view is as special as you say...

TextContext.SourceString: 多花在路上的时间，也就不算浪费。
TextContext.LocalizedString: then any extra time spent on the road will be worth it.

TextContext.SourceString: 不会让你失望的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I won't let you down.

TextContext.SourceString: 可以睁开眼睛了吧——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Can I open my eyes now—
Wow...

TextContext.SourceString: 确实是难能一见的美景呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This truly is breathtaking...

TextParam.SourceString: 尽管不舍，烟花表演结束后，夜空重新沉寂了下来。
TextParam.LocalizedString: Though everyone was reluctant to leave, once the fireworks display ended, the night sky slowly became silent once more.

TextContext.SourceString: 最开始明明是我想约你出来，最后，却是你给我带来了这样的惊喜。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I was the one who wanted to invite you out, yet you’ve managed to surprise me like this.

TextContext.SourceString: 你总能出乎我的意料。谢谢，有心了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You always manage to catch me off guard. Thank you, it really means a lot.

TextContext.SourceString: 这一年，奥黛丽也辛苦了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's been a tough year for you too, Audrey.

TextContext.SourceString: 辛苦……为什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tough... why?

TextContext.SourceString: 今年是于你于我，都复杂而艰涩的一年……居然只是用“辛苦”来形容吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: This year was challenging for both of us. "Tough" seems too simplistic, don't you think?

TextContext.SourceString: 因为我们在做必须做的事，尽应尽的责任。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Because we're doing what we must, fulfilling our responsibilities.

TextContext.SourceString: 所经历的一切，都只是必要的“辛苦”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: All we've been through, it's just necessary "toughness.”

TextContext.SourceString: 而且我们都坚持到最后了，不是吗？能与你一起站在夜空之下，共赏美丽的烟花，以此作为“辛苦”的回报。
TextContext.LocalizedString: And we came through it all, right? Standing here with you under this vast night sky, watching the beautiful fireworks, feels like the perfect reward for all that "toughness.”

TextContext.SourceString: 我感到很“幸福”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I feel truly "happy."

TextContext.SourceString: （与奥黛丽并肩站在夜空之下，安谧温馨的氛围在空气中流淌。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Standing beside Audrey beneath the night sky, a serene and warm atmosphere fills the air.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这么快就到了，夜晚的街道还真是畅行无阻。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Did we get here that quickly? The streets are so clear at night.

TextContext.SourceString: 因为我们看得比其他人都要久……
TextContext.LocalizedString: We had front-row seats, longer than anyone.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊？我们居然看了很久？总觉得，还可以再多看一会。
TextContext.LocalizedString: What? We've been here for that long? It feels like we could watch a bit longer.

TextContext.SourceString: 算了，这样就足够了。否则当这份感觉离去的时候，一定会更加难以忍受。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh well, this is enough. Otherwise, it’d be hard to cope once the feeling fades.

TextContext.SourceString: 总之，今天谢谢了，引航者。我过得很开心。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Anyway, thanks for today, Navigator. I had a wonderful time.

TextContext.SourceString: 回礼稍后会由我的管家送上。希望……下次还能有这样的机会。
TextContext.LocalizedString: A token of gratitude will be sent by my butler later. I hope... we get to do this again.

TextContext.SourceString: 再会。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Till next time.

TextContext.SourceString: （某天，突然收到了米雪儿的信息轰炸：电话，短信，甚至还有游戏私信……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (One day, I suddenly got bombarded with messages from Michele: phone calls, texts, and even in-game DMs...)

TextContext.SourceString: （可惜，因为当时忙于庆典筹备，全部错过了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Unfortunately, I missed them all because I was busy with festival preparations.)

TextContext.SourceString: （闲下来后，决定应邀前往猫咪咖啡厅一探究竟。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Once I had some free time, I decided to accept the invitation to check out the Cat Café.)

TextContext.SourceString: 曾为我指引方向的伙伴啊，你终于被勇者米雪儿召唤出来了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: My friend and mentor, the brave Michele has finally summoned you!

TextContext.SourceString: 勇者历经千辛万难，终于获得命运的馈赠，而她，想要将这份馈赠与伙伴共享……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lo, this valiant adventurer hath traversed the treacherous depths and perilous heights to lay claim to a boon, which she now seeks to bestow upon her comrades in arms!

TextContext.SourceString: 稍等，我去请个翻译……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hold up, let me grab a translator…

TextContext.SourceString: 诶诶诶，别走别走，我说人话！最近不是搜查队的成员都要承接庆典筹备的工作嘛……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey, hey, hey, don’t go! I'll talk normally! You know how all my P.U.S team members are helping with festival prep lately?

TextContext.SourceString: 米雪儿警官，以最快的速度完成了全部任务，获得了两张烟花庆典最前排的门票！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Officer Michele finished her tasks at lightning speed and scored two front-row tickets to the fireworks festival!

TextContext.SourceString: 总觉得听过这句话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: That sounds kinda familiar…

TextContext.SourceString: 总觉得有股既视感……
TextContext.LocalizedString: This gives me some serious déjà vu...

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，我想把其中一张票送给我的伙伴引航者……
TextContext.LocalizedString: And so, I wanted to give one of my tickets to my partner in crime...

TextContext.SourceString: 意思是，我想邀请你和我一起去参加烟花庆典！听说庆典上会有各种好吃的好玩的，我们还可以近距离看烟花……
TextContext.LocalizedString: What I mean is... I want to invite you to the fireworks festival! I'm told that there's going to be all kinds of delicious food and fun activities. We'll even be able to watch the fireworks up close...

TextContext.SourceString: 想想就超级好玩！拜托拜托，答应我吧，伙伴！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm getting excited just thinking about it! Please, please! Just say yes, partner!

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴说没问题！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Absolutely, count me in!

TextContext.SourceString: 勇闯烟花庆典！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's adventure into the celebrations!

TextContext.SourceString: 太好了！就知道伙伴你最好了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Awesome! I knew I could count on you!

TextContext.SourceString: 那我这几天执行任务的时候先做做攻略，我们烟花庆典不见不散啦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll draw up our battle plan when I have some free time over the next few days. See you at the fireworks—be there or be square!

TextParam.SourceString: 在期盼之中，烟花庆典之日终于到来了。
TextParam.LocalizedString: The day of the much-anticipated fireworks festival has finally arrived.

TextContext.SourceString: 带上了足够的水和零食！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've packed plenty of water and snacks!

TextContext.SourceString: HP已补满！
TextContext.LocalizedString: HP fully restored!

TextContext.SourceString: 折叠椅，游戏机，漫画书也准备好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Got my folding chair, gaming console, and comic books ready too.

TextContext.SourceString: 这就有点夸张了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Isn't that a bit much...?

TextContext.SourceString: 可是听说庆典场所附近堵车很严重，我想带点在路上能打发时间的东西……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I heard traffic near the festival is a nightmare, so I thought it’d be good to have stuff to keep us entertained...

TextContext.SourceString: 什么都不用准备。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You didn't have to do that.

TextContext.SourceString: 我带你走捷径！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll show you a shortcut!

TextContext.SourceString: 隐藏通路吗？不愧是伙伴，办法真多！那我就放心跟着你走啦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: A hidden path? That's more like it, partner! Just lead the way!

TextContext.SourceString: 哇……这也太好看了吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whoa... This is so pretty!

TextContext.SourceString: 不，不许笑我！看到亮晶晶的东西想去抓一下也是人之常情……
TextContext.LocalizedString: D-Don't laugh! It's only natural to reach for something that sparkles...

TextParam.SourceString: 尽管不舍，烟花表演结束后，夜空重新沉寂了下来。
TextParam.LocalizedString: Though everyone was reluctant to leave, once the fireworks display ended, the night sky slowly became silent once more.

TextContext.SourceString: 结果居然是带我爬楼梯上了天台……
TextContext.LocalizedString: So we were heading to the rooftop...

TextContext.SourceString: 要不是和伙伴一起，我就直接弦化飞上去了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If it wasn't for you, I would have just stringified and glided right up...

TextContext.SourceString: 不觉得爬完楼再看烟花感觉更美吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't the fireworks look prettier after putting in the effort to climb up here?

TextContext.SourceString: 这就是苦尽甘来！
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's the sweet reward after hard work!

TextContext.SourceString: 好吧，你说得也有道理。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I guess you've got a point.

TextContext.SourceString: 确实，从狭窄的楼梯通道爬出来，看到天空的一刹那，真的感觉一切都值了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Seeing the sky made all the climbing worth it!

TextContext.SourceString: 米雪儿表现得比我想象中淡定哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You've been surprisingly calm, Michele.

TextContext.SourceString: 诶，是吗？我可绝对绝对没有不喜欢烟花庆典的意思啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh? Is that so? Don't think for a second this means I don't love fireworks!

TextContext.SourceString: 不如说，是太喜欢了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: In fact... I absolutely love them!

TextContext.SourceString: 为了明年和之后的每一年都能举办烟花庆典，为了每个人都能像我和伙伴一样，感受到这份喜悦的心情……
TextContext.LocalizedString: To make sure there’s a fireworks festival next year and every year after, so everyone can feel the joy we did...

TextContext.SourceString: 之后的米雪儿，也会一直努力的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I promise, future Michele will keep giving it her all!

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，请你一定要亲眼见证唷！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Partner, you've got to see this for yourself.

TextContext.SourceString: 可真是意犹未尽……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I wish there was even more to enjoy...

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，看这么多就足够了。虽然沿途的风景很美丽，但勇者的步伐还是要往前呀。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But for now, I'm satisfied. No matter how beautiful the journey, a hero must keep moving forward.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，命运的馈赠，只要享受过就很好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We should feel lucky to have experienced fate’s blessings.

TextContext.SourceString: 米雪儿长大了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Michele, you've really grown up.

TextContext.SourceString: 米雪儿成熟了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You've matured, Michele.

TextContext.SourceString: 是吗？大概是因为，现在有伙伴在为勇者引航吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Have I? I guess it's thanks to having a special partner guiding my path.

TextContext.SourceString: 对了对了，记得查收我的礼——记得查收命运的馈赠礼！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, and don’t forget to check out my gift—or should I say, the gift of fate!

TextContext.SourceString: 之后，再继续我们的旅途吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: After that, let's continue our journey!

TextContext.SourceString: （收到玛德蕾娜的短信，希望有空的时候去她宿舍一趟。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I got a text from Maddelena asking me to visit her when I had the time.)

TextContext.SourceString: （最近星庇所的病人不多，加上沐春将近，可以比平时更早下班。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Things have been quite slow at the Astral Sanctuary lately, and with the festival approaching, I'll be clocking out earlier than usual.)

TextContext.SourceString: （那么，就先去拜访玛德蕾娜吧。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Alright. I guess I should pay Maddelena a visit.)

TextContext.SourceString: 咚咚咚——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ding dong!

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，你这么快就来啦~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator! You got here fast!

TextContext.SourceString: 这样，我们灵感收集小分队的成员就到齐了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now our little inspiration-gathering squad has assembled.

TextContext.SourceString: 这就到齐了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just the two of us?

TextContext.SourceString: 什么小分队？
TextContext.LocalizedString: The what now?

TextContext.SourceString: 人是有点少……但可都是精英！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Our numbers may be few... but we make up for it in talent!

TextContext.SourceString: 为了在烟花庆典上大放异彩而成立的“灵感收集小分队”！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Our mission is simple: to steal the show at the fireworks celebration!

TextContext.SourceString: 是这样，引航者应该也有听说，今年的沐春节会举办传——说中的烟花庆典吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm sure you've heard, Navigator. To celebrate this year's Spring Blessings, they're holding a huge fireworks display!

TextContext.SourceString: 先是一束光芒升空，然后散落成漫天焰火，并伴随着热闹的声音：砰——噼里啪啦咻咻咻——应该会是这样美丽的场景吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Imagine it—a single beam of light soaring up, exploding and scattering all across the sky, followed by a symphony of 'bangs' and 'crackles.' It's going to be unforgettable!

TextContext.SourceString: 咳，本人不才，正好被官方邀请参与了烟花的设计~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ahem, and yours truly here got the nod to pitch in with the fireworks design!

TextContext.SourceString: 因此，我特意成立了灵感收集小分队，我是队长，你是荣誉队长，我们一起出发，去收集灵感，为大家呈现一场绚丽的烟花庆典吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, I formed our little inspiration-gathering squad. I'll be the captain, and you'll be my second-in-command. Let's set sail and collect the inspiration we need to create the best fireworks display ever!

TextContext.SourceString: 确实有听说这个庆典……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The fireworks celebration does sound familiar...

TextContext.SourceString: 我还收到了庆典筹备的邀请函。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I was also invited to help with the preparations.

TextContext.SourceString: 你也收到了邀请？我看人的眼光很可以嘛！你参与的是哪个部分呀？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You got an invite too? Seems like I've got quite the knack for spotting talent! Which part are you involved in?

TextContext.SourceString: 几乎全流程吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Pretty much everything...

TextContext.SourceString: 呃……其中一项是烟花设计的审核。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Um... Actually, I was supposed to help review the fireworks design.

TextContext.SourceString: 什么……你负责审核！！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: What?? You're the one reviewing my work?!

TextContext.SourceString: 那岂不是……不能陪我去找灵感了……否则就算作弊……小分队，被迫解散……
TextContext.LocalizedString: So does that mean... you can't join me on the inspiration hunt...? If you did then I guess it would count as cheating... We're gonna have to disband...

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然不能陪你去找，
TextContext.LocalizedString: I might not be able to help you find inspiration,

TextContext.SourceString: 但我很期待你寻觅到的灵感。
TextContext.LocalizedString: but I'm really looking forward to seeing what you come up with.

TextContext.SourceString: 呜……好！我又打起精神了！为了不辜负你的期待，我会努力的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Aww... Alright, then! The winds are back in my sails! I won't let you down!

TextContext.SourceString: 我相信你！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I have faith in you!

TextParam.SourceString: 在期盼之中，烟花庆典之日终于到来了。
TextParam.LocalizedString: The day of the much-anticipated fireworks festival has finally arrived.

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，你来得刚好，我正要去找你呢！说好今晚一起看烟花庆典，还以为你忘了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, you’re just in time! I was about to come looking for you. We agreed to watch the fireworks together, and I thought you might've forgotten...

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么会忘呢，只是路上太堵了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: How could I forget? The traffic was just a nightmare.

TextContext.SourceString: 我要是能弦化飞过来就好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If only I could stringify and glide over...

TextContext.SourceString: 没关系，我们不用跟其他人抢前排的位置。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No biggie! We won't have to fight for the best seats.

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟不少人从中午就开始排队了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Some of the people here have been in the queue since noon...

TextContext.SourceString: 我在寻找灵感的途中，发现了一个绝佳的观景点，你一定也会超级喜欢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: But on my quest for inspiration, I stumbled upon a perfect viewing spot. You'll absolutely love it!

TextContext.SourceString: 还等什么，我们走吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stop dawdling! Let's go!

TextContext.SourceString: 走，看烟花去！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright, let's go!

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，我有点词穷……要是时间能永远停留在这一刻就好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, I'm at a loss for words... If only we could freeze time in this moment forever.

TextParam.SourceString: 尽管不舍，烟花表演结束后，夜空重新沉寂了下来。
TextParam.LocalizedString: Though everyone was reluctant to leave, once the fireworks display ended, the night sky slowly became silent once more.

TextContext.SourceString: 烟花真的、真的好漂亮啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The fireworks... they're just so beautiful!

TextContext.SourceString: 但，为什么看到这么美丽又盛大的景象后，心里反而有点说不出的难过呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But... why do I feel this inexplicable sadness after seeing something so majestic...?

TextContext.SourceString: 是我太贪心了吗？想着要是能把烟花升空的画面，永远定格就好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Am I being too greedy? Wishing to hold onto the moment those fireworks light up the sky forever?

TextContext.SourceString: 很正常，玛德蕾娜。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's normal, Maddelena.

TextContext.SourceString: 美好总是转瞬即逝的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Beautiful things are often fleeting.

TextContext.SourceString: 你说得对。或许艺术诞生的目的之一，就是为了让刹那变成永恒吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're right. Maybe that's why art exists—to hold moments of beauty in eternity.

TextContext.SourceString: 我该怎么让它停留呢？拍个照？画下来？还是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But through what medium? A photo? A painting? Or...

TextContext.SourceString: 不需要哦，“记住”就好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just capture it in your memory.

TextContext.SourceString: 诶？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh?

TextContext.SourceString: 抬头吧。不要为了留住过去，而错过眼前。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Look up. Don't miss the present by holding on to the past.

TextContext.SourceString: 好！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright!

TextContext.SourceString: （与玛德蕾娜静静仰望着天空，直到最后一束烟花落下。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We quietly watched the night sky until the last firework fizzled out.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在参加完烟花庆典后，送玛德蕾娜回到了宿舍。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After the celebrations, I walked Maddelena back to her dorm.)

TextContext.SourceString: （正准备告别时，对方突然有些不好意思地递过来一个东西。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I was about to say goodbye, she shyly offered me something.)

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然说，能拥有这段记忆已经很好了，但毕竟是我们第一次一起参加的烟花庆典……还是想留个纪念。
TextContext.LocalizedString: These memories are precious. It was the first time we watched the fireworks together, after all. That said... I still want you to have this for keepsake.

TextContext.SourceString: 这个是我在寻找灵感期间做的小玩意儿，我想把它送给你！
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is a little something I made while searching for inspiration. It's yours now!

TextContext.SourceString: 这么突然？
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is a surprise!

TextContext.SourceString: 哦？无功不受禄诶。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh? I can’t accept this without earning it.

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟也是为了不辜负你的期待，才设计出了自己也很满意的作品。你明明就有很大的功劳嘛！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Well, it's because of your encouragement that I created something I'm truly proud of. You've played a big part in this!

TextContext.SourceString: 明年的烟花庆典，一定要跟我组队参加哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Make sure you team up with me again for next year's celebration, okay?!

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿——引航者！看起来很有精神嘛！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey there, Navigator! Looking lively today, aren't ya?

TextContext.SourceString: 听说除了星庇所的工作，你最近还忙着筹备庆典，怎样，应付得过来吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heard you've been pulling double duty at the Astral Sanctuary and getting those festival plans in order. How’s it going? Feeling swamped yet?

TextContext.SourceString: 还有余力！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Still got plenty of energy!

TextContext.SourceString: 轻轻松松！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a breeze!

TextContext.SourceString: 那就太好了~这样，我就能理直气壮地约你陪我去看烟花庆典了吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sweet! That means I can officially rope you into catching the fireworks with me, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 虽说庆典会举办很多场，但我想，第一场还是该和最重要的伙伴一起看。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm sure there will be many more, but I figured the first one should be enjoyed with my closest partner.

TextContext.SourceString: 那天，你……应该有空吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You'll be free... right?

TextContext.SourceString: 陪心夏去看庆典这种好事，
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hanging out with you, Kokona? Always!

TextContext.SourceString: 当然什么时候喊我都有空啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just say the word and I'm there!

TextContext.SourceString: 你这么说的话，到时候我就直接喊你了哦，可不要迟到呀！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll ping you when it's time. Don’t leave me hanging, okay?

TextContext.SourceString: 没问题！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You got it!

TextParam.SourceString: 在期盼之中，烟花庆典之日终于到来了。
TextParam.LocalizedString: The day of the much-anticipated fireworks festival has finally arrived.

TextContext.SourceString: 准备好要出发了对吧！紧张紧张，激动激动~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ready to head out? I'm both nervous and excited!

TextContext.SourceString: 整装待发了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: All set and ready to roll!

TextContext.SourceString: 今天的“心夏前辈”很不淡定啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wow, someone’s extra hyped today!

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟我也没有真的看过烟花嘛。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Well, it’s my first real fireworks show, you know?

TextContext.SourceString: 呃，在街区巡逻时被熊孩子扔的闪光弹可不算……
TextContext.LocalizedString: And no, those flashbangs those little punks tossed while I was on patrol don’t count...

TextContext.SourceString: 好，那就满怀着期待，
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright, let's go with high hopes!

TextContext.SourceString: 一起去看真正的烟花吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's watch some real fireworks together!

TextContext.SourceString: 这就是真正的烟花……好厉害……好漂亮啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: These are the real deal... Wow... So beautiful!

TextParam.SourceString: 尽管不舍，烟花表演结束后，夜空重新沉寂了下来。
TextParam.LocalizedString: Though everyone was reluctant to leave, once the fireworks display ended, the night sky slowly became silent once more.

TextContext.SourceString: 烟花，光用眼睛看可不够，我要用上特制的望远镜！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just watching with my eyes isn’t enough. Time to bust out my special telescope!

TextContext.SourceString: （忍着笑看心夏假装摸索一番后，有模有样地戴上了“手指望远镜”。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I hold back a chuckle as Kokona fumbles around to make a "telescope" out of her fingers.)

TextContext.SourceString: 可别小看了我的望远镜，用它不但能看到烟花，还能看到很多别的东西呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don’t underestimate my telescope. It can see way more than just fireworks.

TextContext.SourceString: 哦？那我很好奇，还看到了什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh? You've piqued my curiosity. What else can you see?

TextContext.SourceString: 看到了“未来”哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I see the "future," of course.

TextContext.SourceString: 这个世界和引航者的未来一定会越来越好！
TextContext.LocalizedString: A future where this world and your journey get better and better!

TextContext.SourceString: 好准的预测，我信了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Spot-on prediction. I’m convinced!

TextContext.SourceString: 心夏牌望远镜，值得信赖！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Kokona-brand telescope, reliable as ever!

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿嘿，毕竟这是我们一起守护的世界嘛。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hehe, well, it's the world we’re protecting together, after all.

TextContext.SourceString: 我们共同迈进的未来，一定会越来越好的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We'll build a better future. I'm sure of it.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，真是好满足啊——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah, that was so satisfying!

TextContext.SourceString: 看完这么盛大的烟花庆典，就像吃了一整条街的大排档一样满足。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Watching such a grand fireworks display is like devouring all the street food on an entire block. Just pure satisfaction.

TextContext.SourceString: 可能这就是“对我眼睛好”吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I guess that's what "a feast for the eyes" really means.

TextContext.SourceString: 神奇的比喻又增加了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Another one for the books of magical metaphors...

TextContext.SourceString: 顺便恭喜你，作为和我看第一场烟花的人，你会收到一份代表着好运的神秘礼物~
TextContext.LocalizedString: And hey, congrats! Since you were the first to watch the fireworks with me, I have a feeling you'll be getting a special good luck gift!

TextContext.SourceString: 你也太幸运了吧~
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're just that lucky, aren't you?

TextContext.SourceString: 我也太幸运了吧~
TextContext.LocalizedString: I really am that lucky!

TextContext.SourceString: 感谢幸运女神的黑箱~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thanks for the gift, Lady Luck!

TextContext.SourceString: 嘘，看破不说破——总之，下次再一起去看烟花吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Shh! Don't ruin the magic. But hey, let's catch more fireworks together next time!

TextContext.SourceString: （在忙碌的庆典筹备期间，突然想起有段时间没见过拉薇了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (During the hustle and bustle of preparing for the celebrations, I suddenly remembered that it had been a while since I last saw Lawine.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她曾经和我提起过家乡迎接新一年的习俗，和沐春节有几分相似……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She once mentioned her hometown's New Year traditions; they sounded a lot like the Spring Blessings...)

TextContext.SourceString: （还是找个机会去拜访她好了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Maybe now's a good time to pay her a visit.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你来了，近日可还安好？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey, you're here. How have things been lately?

TextContext.SourceString: 最近在街上遇到过你几次，你都在忙，所以想了想，还是没有和你打招呼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I saw you out and about a few times over the last week, but you always seemed busy, so I didn't want to intrude.

TextContext.SourceString: 沐春对卡丘人而言，是一个重要的节日。所以请放心，这段时间剪刀手不但不会采取任何行动，我们还会帮助排查潜在的安全隐患。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Spring Blessings is a big deal for us Strinovians. Rest assured, The Scissors will not attempt to disrupt the festival. We'll also help maintain safety if need be.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊那倒不是因为这个。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, it's not about that.

TextContext.SourceString: 我是来邀请拉薇的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm actually here to invite you, Lawine.

TextContext.SourceString: 邀请……我？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Invite... me?

TextContext.SourceString: 我想邀请拉薇，和我一起参加烟花庆典。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I want to invite you to join me for the fireworks festival.

TextContext.SourceString: 我明白你为什么会邀请我了。但没关系，不用感觉怜悯——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I get why you'd want to invite me, but there’s no need to take pity—

TextContext.SourceString: 是对朋友发起的邀约。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I wanted to invite you as a friend.

TextContext.SourceString: 你愿意陪我一起吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Will you accompany me?

TextContext.SourceString: 明白了，好。我会记住这个约定，静候那一天的到来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I see... okay. I'll remember this and look forward to that day.

TextParam.SourceString: 在期盼之中，烟花庆典之日终于到来了。
TextParam.LocalizedString: The day of the much-anticipated fireworks festival has finally arrived.

TextContext.SourceString: 我已经准备妥当，随时可以出发。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm all set and ready to go.

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，我这样出现在你身边，会不会太显眼？需不需要乔装打扮一下……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Still, standing next to you like this, won't I stand out too much? Should I maybe disguise myself a little...?

TextContext.SourceString: 不必，保持拉薇原本的样子就好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No need, just be yourself, Lawine.

TextContext.SourceString: 我会在前面为你领路。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll lead the way.

TextContext.SourceString: 好，我会跟紧你的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright. I'll stay close to you.

TextContext.SourceString: 这样的景色，我曾在梦中见过……
TextContext.LocalizedString: This view... I've seen it before, in dreams...

TextContext.SourceString: 但和亲眼所见，感受完全不同。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But nothing beats the feeling of seeing it for real.

TextContext.SourceString: 我更喜欢当下这种感觉。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I prefer the way it feels right now.

TextParam.SourceString: 尽管不舍，烟花表演结束后，夜空重新沉寂了下来。
TextParam.LocalizedString: Though everyone was reluctant to leave, once the fireworks display ended, the night sky slowly became silent once more.

TextContext.SourceString: 谢谢你，引航者。如果不是你的邀约，恐怕此番美景，我只会透过窗台远远看一眼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you, Navigator. If you hadn't invited me here, I would’ve just admired this view from afar.

TextContext.SourceString: 那么此刻的感受、此刻的心境，我都不会拥有了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: These feelings, this perspective... I wouldn’t have them otherwise.

TextContext.SourceString: 我很好奇，当时的你在想什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm curious, what were you thinking at that moment?

TextContext.SourceString: 呵……我在想，与广袤的夜幕相比，我是如此渺小；与璀璨的烟花相比，我是如此黯淡……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heh... I was reflecting on how tiny I am compared to this vast sky, and how dim in comparison to these bright fireworks...

TextContext.SourceString: 但这些都是我已经意识到的既定事实。
TextContext.LocalizedString: These are truths I've accepted a long time ago.

TextContext.SourceString: 这种想法不会让我恐惧，只会推着我向前。除了……除了有点孤独外，感觉不坏。
TextContext.LocalizedString: They don't scare me. In fact, they push me forward. It's just... a bit lonely.

TextContext.SourceString: 感觉孤独的话，可以随时来找我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you're ever lonely, just remember I'm here for you.

TextContext.SourceString: 如果无法同行，至少我是你能停靠的港湾。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Even if we can't always chart the same course, I'm your safe harbor.

TextContext.SourceString: 港湾啊……好，港湾。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Safe harbor... Alright.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇仰头望向夜空。这一次，她的眼中带着笑意。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine tilts her head back, gazing at the night sky. This time, there's a gentle smile in her eyes.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯……既然你来了，我就把之前准备的沐春礼物给你吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm... Since you're here, I should give you your Spring Blessings gift.

TextContext.SourceString: 看到觉得很适合你，所以就买下来了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: When I spotted it through the window, I thought it would be perfect for you.

TextContext.SourceString: 之前担心在沐春期间见不到你，没有送出去的机会。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I was worried I wouldn’t get the chance to hand it over, thinking we might not cross paths much during the festivities.

TextContext.SourceString: 还好……这样，我的沐春就没有遗憾了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But thankfully... now my Spring Blessings feels complete.

TextContext.SourceString: 你回去以后再打开看吧？如果喜欢的话，稍微告诉我一声就好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Open it once you're home, okay? If you like it, just drop me a note.

TextContext.SourceString: 好，我会好好珍惜的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright. I'll be sure to cherish it.

TextContext.SourceString: （与拉薇道别。感受到她目光温柔地注视着我，许久才渐渐消散。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I said my goodbyes to Lawine, I felt her gentle gaze linger on me. That feeling stayed with me long after I returned home.)

TextContext.SourceString: 喂喂喂，引航者，听得到吗？设备显示你突然退出了群聊，吓死我了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 要不然你出来吧？里面信号太差了，我很担心……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 我没问题，不用担心！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 探险哪有回头路！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 明明是我缠着心夏姐想来这里探险的，却是引航者替我们负重前行……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 呃啊！感觉被愧疚扼住了咽喉！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然我觉得，传闻中那些诡异香气、幽灵脚步声、惨白人脸应该都能找到科学解释……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 但引航者孤身前往的话，我还是无法放心。或者，我跟你一起去吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 心夏，别说了！本来不怕的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 既然如此，更不能让你们来了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 好吧，那你一定要小心哦！我和心夏姐会在门口等你的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （关闭通讯设备后，耳畔只剩下死一般的寂静。啊呸呸呸，不能说那个字……在流传着灵异怪谈的医院内，提到“死”这样的字眼，实在是太不吉利了！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （几天前，一则名为“救！在医院遇到了灵异事件！”的热贴一直飘在论坛首页。贴主绘声绘色描述了自己住院期间遇到的种种诡异现象，贴内还有不少亲历者现身说法。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （贴内提及的联合医院位置偏远，最开始只是一家小诊所。最近获得了投资，不但扩建了二层，还增加了住院服务。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （只是，根据患者们的描述，这个住院服务虽然能疗愈身体，但却会让心灵饱受惊吓，以至于服务刚开没多久，病人就全都跑光了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 好香啊，什么味道……不对，这难道是？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （摸索着在走廊中前行的时候，我突然闻到了一股异香。那香味淡雅柔和但极其持久，几乎将我包裹在其中。和传闻对上了，诡异的幽香！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 呼。淡定。这一定是消毒水的味道，嗯，为了舒缓患者心情而特制的消毒水罢了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （我硬着头皮继续往前走，边走边腹诽这条走廊为何如此漫长。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!
!NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 脚步声？是有人吗？你好？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （此时，远处又传来了脚步声。尽管疑虑于这脚步声为何如此沉重，我还是小跑几步追了上去。但诡异的是，脚步声走着走着突然变轻了，甚至，消失了……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 难道这就是幽灵的脚步……又和传闻对上了？要不然还是让心夏来接我吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 通讯设备一格信号都没有，真的假的？！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （我站在走廊正中间，着实是进退两难了。往前走，似乎要被黑暗吞噬；往后退，身为引航者的自尊心又不允许……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 算了！能屈能伸才能成大事！先找个空房间躲一下，让心夏来接我……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （我一咬牙，一跺脚，决心放弃与惨白人脸正面对决的机会，找个安全屋稍作休息。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!
!NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （我钻进一间没有人的病房，刚准备平复一下心情，就听到身后传来一声巨响。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （而一转头，窗户上映出了一张人脸！它先我一步，正往出口的方向飘去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （心夏和玛德蕾娜还在门口！我惊出一身冷汗，保护欲取代了恐惧，一瞬间为我注入了无穷的力量。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 是谁在外面！有本事冲我来！别去找其他人！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （我颤抖的声音划破了黑暗。惨白人脸似乎也迟疑了一下，随后慢慢、慢慢飘向了我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （我举起心夏塞给我的探照灯作为武器，向它走了过去——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （咚——眼前的世界突然翻转，我也失去了意识，陷入无边的黑暗中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 谁在……地板上……放花瓶……啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （醒来了，但不知身在何处。眼前是明亮洁净的窗景，微风带来了花朵的芬芳，如果不是浑身都疼的话，躺着还挺舒服的。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 哎呀，你终于醒啦。一个小时前，你的两位朋友才离开呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 那个……只是轻微脑震荡，多加休息就好……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 在痊愈之前，你就安心地呆在我们联合医院住院部吧！目前，你是唯一的病人哦，我们一定会好好照顾你的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: ……这里是哪里？！你们是谁？！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 距离今天的游行开始还有十五分钟，请各位参赛选手做好准备！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 也请占用了主干道的观众朋友们调整位置，把道路留给我们的参赛选手……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 我要拍照，我得站前排！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 我为了抢视线最好的位置，提前了三个小时来排队，现在给我说要往后撤？？门儿都没有！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 啊——你们谁踩我脚了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （游行快开始了，现场依旧无序。我站在临时搭建出的评委休息区内，忍不住和星绘交换了一个无奈的眼神。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 别叹气了，前辈，昨天场面更加混乱呢，还好你没来。据说白墨先生在提出倡议后就失踪了，完全联系不上，也没有跟进这次活动的举办。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 如果不是奥黛丽小姐看不下去，临时接手了这次活动，我们连现在站的位置都没有。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 哈哈哈，这活动如此有吸引力，又如此劝退……只能说这很白墨。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 但，这不是重点！咱们不是来给奥黛丽帮忙的吗，具体要做什么，收集观众的投票并进行统计就好了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 是的，玩家会在观看游行的过程中，为各位参赛选手投票。因为设立了许多奖项，什么最佳装扮、最佳视觉、最佳服装啦，所以这次采用的是线上投票的方式。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 投票的二维码印在为参加活动的观众发放的糖果包装里——顺带一提，这也是白墨先生的建议。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，他们昨天就为每位参加活动的观众发了糖果，但今天才告知他们这是投票道具，糖纸内有二维码？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: ……真是辛苦奥黛丽了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 还好有奥黛丽小姐！否则今天，我们的工作也要从翻垃圾桶开始……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 前面什么动静？怎么这么吵，有人打起来了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 有点不妙……前辈，我们赶紧过去看看吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （首先是一声尖锐爆鸣，不，应该是有很多声尖锐爆鸣，但因为距离逐渐衰减，到达我所在的位置时，已经变成了虚弱的求救。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 昨天！昨天我就看到了，还以为是幻觉……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 绝对不是，它、它又来了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 有真鬼混进游行队伍里了！大家快——逃——啊——！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （这名观众扯着脖子喊出最后一句话后，极具悲壮色彩地倒了下去，大概是昏厥了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （现场顿时陷入一片混乱。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （以他为中心的人群就像被投入了石子的湖面，荡起了无法平息的波纹。人们面面相觑，怀疑地看着彼此，而当第一个旁观者开始慌不择路地后撤时，一切就有点收不住了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 请大家保持镇定！听从现场人员的指挥！不要互相推搡啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 急救人员来了，请让一让！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: (手忙脚乱地将这位观众抬上救护车后，面色不善的奥黛丽也从中控室来到了现场，身后还跟着三位奇装异服、张牙舞爪的……怪人。)
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 好了，在他醒来之前，你们还有最后一轮为自己辩驳的机会。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 二维码投票结果显示，他只为你们三位投了票，且他倒下的时间就在投完票不久之后，原因是惊吓过度导致的暂时性昏厥……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 魔女小姐、僵尸妹妹和南瓜头先生，你们谁是那个“真正的鬼魂”呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （而那位身材高大、头顶南瓜的怪人，已经做出了拔腿要跑的姿势。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 你小子跑什么？欸！你们俩也给我站住！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 蜡烛……燃尽了呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 只能闻到残余在空气中的甜香。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 在黑暗中失去指引的我们，究竟何时才能得到救赎？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 等我们修好电闸就可以了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 等等，这个香味怎么这么稀薄……艾卡？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 到！我我我只是想尝尝这块蛋糕烤得够不够好，不是因为嘴馋才吃光的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 呃，而且我还剩了点……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 烤箱里新的蛋糕马上要出炉了，一定不会耽误招待客人的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （在幽深的黑暗中，突然亮起了一丛烛光。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （循着这点光亮，众人终于得以在一片混乱中成功重启了跳掉的电闸，光明瞬间充斥了整间屋子。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 管家先生，我就说“将枪的前半段改造成烛台形的点火器”是个很棒的主意，对吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 我同意！下次可以将它改造成喷枪吗，星绘小姐？我最近学会了做炙烤三文鱼！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 咳。作为执事和女仆，我们的任务是将潜在的隐患排除，而不是制造新的隐患。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 客人都来得差不多了，答应我，绝对不要在晚宴上用枪口对准客人，好吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 放心吧，我们可是专业的女仆——
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （突兀而急促的敲门声响起，打破了闲适的氛围，也瞬间引起了大厅内三人的警觉。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么会有人找来这里？客人们都被指引去前厅等待了呀。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 艾卡，你手写每一封邀请函的时候，都核对过地址吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 当、当然了！邀请函是星绘小姐检查过的！真是的，就算不信任我的话，至少能信任星绘小姐吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 这并非出于任何个人感情，仅仅是我从过去经验中产生的判断，不要多想。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 嘘——敲门声越来越快，看来我们的“客人”已经等不及了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 离晚宴开始还有一些时间，让我们会会这位“神秘的客人”吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （天气晴朗，万里无云，是个出游的好天气。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It's a cloudless, sunny day, perfect for an outing.)

TextContext.SourceString: （如果不是身负天降的“神圣使命”，我大概也会和朋友们去郊外的公园野餐。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (If it weren't for this special mission. I'd probably be having a picnic in the park with my friends.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不过，作为市民代表参加卡丘学园的校园开放日，并为社团评优投出极具分量的一票……这个热闹我可不会错过。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But today, I'm the citizen representative at Strinova Academy's open day, I have the important task of casting a decisive vote for the club competition... There's no way I'd miss this.)

TextContext.SourceString: （啊，这应该就是约定的地方了。说是会有学生会的人在等我……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (This should be it. I was told someone from the student council would meet me here...)

TextContext.SourceString: 你是引航者吧，我是学生会负责接待你的奥黛丽·格罗夫。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You must be the Navigator. I'm from the student council. Audrey Grove. A pleasure to meet you.

TextContext.SourceString: 你好，是我。那就麻烦你带我去校园广场了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The pleasure is mine. I'll follow you to the plaza.

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽同学看上去很有气势呢，应该是学生会主席吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You seem quite confident, Miss Audrey. You must be the student council president, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 叫、叫我奥黛丽就好！咳，我暂时只是副主席，学生会主席的名字，你应该在邀请函上看到了，是那个姓白的家伙。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please just call me Audrey. I'm actually the vice president. You should've seen our president's name on your invitation. It's Bai Mo.

TextContext.SourceString: 因为我是转校生，转来这里后还没有经历过学生会的换届，所以暂时只是副主席。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There hasn't been a student council election since I transferred to this school, so I'm only the vice president for now.

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然比起白墨来说，我做了更多工作，这些是大家有目共睹的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've done way more than Bai Mo, and that's obvious to everyone.

TextContext.SourceString: 我本人倒不是很在意头衔，能成为同学与校方沟通的桥梁就够了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But honestly, I don't care much for titles. All I want is to be the bridge between the students and the school's administration.

TextContext.SourceString: 好、好的，奥黛丽！（头衔什么的明明就超在意吧！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ok... I get you. (Well, you clearly do care...)

TextContext.SourceString: 到了，就是这里。在开放日期间，校园广场周围会搭建许多帐篷，每个社团可以征用一到两个，用来开展活动、吸引观众并获得投票。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Here we are. We have set up tents around the school plaza for the open day. Each club may claim up to two tents to host activities, draw in crowds, and win votes.

TextContext.SourceString: 得票越多的社团，来年就能获得更多经费。如果连续几年都拿不到多少票的话……社团可能就要被关闭了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The more votes a club gets, the more funding they'll receive next year. But if they don't receive enough votes for several years in a row... they might be shut down.

TextContext.SourceString: 总之，按照内心的真实想法投出你的票吧。这是“市民代表专属投票印章”，收好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Anyway, feel free to vote for whatever club you like. Here's your citizen representative voting seal.

TextContext.SourceString: 我会一直在广场喷泉这里，有什么问题就来问我吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you need anything, I'll be right here by the fountain.

TextContext.SourceString: （因为这枚醒目的投票印章，我走到哪里，炽热的目光就跟到哪里，让人还有点怪紧张的。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Because of the conspicuous seal, people stare at me wherever I go. It's making me a bit nervous.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但也许因为我是生面孔，虽然也有不少同学上来搭话、发宣传单，不过都礼貌地保持着距——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A few students have approached me with flyers and conversations, but they all kept their distance. Perhaps it's because I'm an outsider...)

TextContext.SourceString: 瞧一瞧看一看，走过路过不要错过！卡丘电玩社，连续三年蝉联最受欢迎学生社团！这位伙伴，你一定很想来游戏的世界冒险吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Come and check it out! Strinova Esports Club has been the Most Popular Student Club three years running! Hey, you there, ready to dive into the gaming world with us?

TextContext.SourceString: 别拽领子——不能呼吸了——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stop pulling my collar... I can't breathe!

TextContext.SourceString: 啊啊啊对不起！我太心急了……嘿嘿。毕竟伙伴你身上别着尊贵的市民徽章，一票顶别人十票，很难不被吸引嘛。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, I'm so sorry! Please forgive me... Your prestigious citizen's badge caught my attention. After all, your vote counts as ten votes!

TextContext.SourceString: 自我介绍一下，我叫米雪儿，是卡丘学园电玩社的宣传部部长，也是一名资深游戏爱好者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Where are my manners? I haven't introduced myself yet. My name is Michele. I'm a hardcore gamer, and the head of public relations of the Strinova Academy Esports Club.

TextContext.SourceString: 我们社团的摊位在那边，摆了好几台游戏机的就是，可以随意选一台试玩~里面还有我们部门自己开发的游戏哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We set up a few consoles in our booth just over there. Feel free to play! We've even got games developed by our team!

TextContext.SourceString: 这是我们的宣传册，你看，近几年组织的电玩活动，都取得了很不错的成绩！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Here's our brochure. Please take a look. We've achieved great results in esports tournaments over the past few years!

TextContext.SourceString: 方便的话，可以给我们投一票吗？真的不想社团被取消……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please consider voting for us! I'd really hate to see our club shut down...

TextContext.SourceString: （卡丘学园的电玩社居然做得这么好！可为什么这么受欢迎的社团会被取消啊？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The Strinova Academy Esports Club is doing amazingly well! But why would such a popular club be at risk of being shut down?)

TextContext.SourceString: 有个疑问。宣传册上罗列的上一年度社团排名，卡丘电玩社不是仅次于学生会的第二名吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I have a question, if you don't mind: According to the brochure, your club was ranked second only to the student council last year, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 为什么会面临被取消的境况呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So why is it at risk of being shut down?

TextContext.SourceString: 因为部分学校领导层觉得学生不该把太多时间花在游戏上，或者说，他们根本就不喜欢游戏。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Some administrators think students spend too much time gaming, or maybe they just don't get what makes games so awesome.

TextContext.SourceString: 我大概理解他们的意思啦……有很多更现实、更迫切的问题摆在面前需要解决，而游戏，似乎只能带来短暂的快乐和麻醉。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I mean, I kinda get it... There are real and urgent issues that need our attention, and gaming only seems to bring temporary joy and distraction.

TextContext.SourceString: 但我保证！电玩社的所有同好，都是真心喜欢游戏的，也是真心想因为游戏变得更好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But trust me, everyone in the club is crazy about games, and we're all about leveling up ourselves too.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，我一定要凝聚大家的力量，把电玩社留下来，明年不光要有更好的社团表现，社团的每个成员也要有进步！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I’m on a quest to rally everyone and keep our club going strong! By next year, we'll not only have top-tier club performance but also hit personal high scores!

TextContext.SourceString: 好！米雪儿一定能做到的！不知道在燃什么，但是燃起来了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Awesome! I believe in you, Michele! And somehow, I'm all fired up too!

TextContext.SourceString: 我的一票请拿好，这是我最后的波纹了——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Here's my vote! This is my final ripple!

TextContext.SourceString: 你可以投好几次票的，不用担心！不过，属于电玩社的这一票我就牢牢握住啦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: No worries, you can vote for multiple clubs! But I’ll definitely cherish your vote for us!

PrologueTitle.SourceString: 放学后回家才是正经事

TextContext.SourceString: （投出了光荣的第一票，我的内心深感满足。不过活动时间还有很久，我也还有很多社团没有参观。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Feeling proud as I cast my first vote. But with plenty of time left, there are still many clubs to explore.)

TextContext.SourceString: 那个方向，聚集了好多人啊……人手一份鲷鱼烧，是烘焙社吗？去看看吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: A huge crowd has gathered over there... and everyone has taiyaki. Must be the Baking Club—I should check it out.

TextContext.SourceString: 欢迎加入归宅部——放学后回家才是最正确的选择——请投票——一票换一块鲷鱼烧——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Welcome to the Go-Home Club. Going home after school is the only correct choice. Please vote for us. One vote for a piece of taiyaki...

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然摊位周围很热闹，但并没有看到任何工作人员。桌上放着一个正在循环播报的大喇叭，以及一个已经空掉的野餐篮。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The booth buzzes with energy, but no staff in sight. Just a looping loudspeaker and an empty picnic basket.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……好空的摊位，好简陋的装饰，好冷漠的声音！
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...An empty booth, plain decor, and a lifeless voice!

TextContext.SourceString: 不过这个鲷鱼烧应该很好吃吧，都被人拿空了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The taiyaki must be tasty. It's all gone.

TextContext.SourceString: 让一让——补货到了——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Excuse me! I've got more taiyaki!

TextContext.SourceString: （一阵香气从身后袭来，芬芳浓郁，带着刚出炉甜品特有的热气，暖融融地飘散在空中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A rich fragrance wafts in from behind, laced with the warmth of freshly baked sweets, making the air deliciously inviting.)

TextContext.SourceString: （面前的少女抱着一盒堆得快满出来的鲷鱼烧也毫不费力，面无表情，眼神中带着一丝居高临下的审视，看来是个狠角色！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The seemingly emotionless girl in front of me holds a nearly overflowing box of taiyaki with ease, her gaze sharp and condescending. She's definitely a tough one!)

TextContext.SourceString: 你来得正好，这是新出炉的鲷鱼烧，拿一块吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You came just in time. The taiyaki is fresh out of the oven. Have a piece.

TextContext.SourceString: 愣着干嘛，拿啊。不投票也没事，我们的票已经够多了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: What are you waiting for? Just take it. You don't have to vote for us; we have enough already.

TextContext.SourceString: 居然态度这么友好吗……那，我就不客气了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: A friendly gesture... Well, don't mind if I do, thanks.

TextContext.SourceString: （小心翼翼地拿过一块还冒着热气的鲷鱼烧，吹了吹，一口咬下去，松软的面包皮和绵密的红豆馅在口中混合。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: I carefully grab a piece, still warm, and give it a gentle blow before taking a bite. The fluffy crust melds with the rich red bean filling.

TextContext.SourceString: （甜而不腻，回味悠长，我不太会形容美食，总之就是非常非常好吃！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Sweet but not overwhelming, leaving a pleasant aftertaste. I'm no food critic, but this taiyaki is absolutely delicious!)

TextContext.SourceString: 好吃对吧？有品位。我是归宅部部长绯莎，你得到我的认可了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Isn't it delicious? You have good taste. I'm Fuchsia, head of the Go-Home Club. I approve of you.

TextContext.SourceString: 呃……我是市民代表引航者，谢谢你的认可？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Uh... Thanks? I'm the citizen representative, the Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 话说归宅部，这名字听上去很独特，是什么意思？而且你们的摊位为什么没有工作人员啊？
TextContext.LocalizedString: By the way, Go-Home Club - that's a unique name. What does it mean? And why don't you have any staff members here?

TextContext.SourceString: 归宅，回家，鼓励大家放学后不在校内逗留、早点回家的社团。整个学校最应该存在的就是我们社团了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We urge students to head straight home after classes. We're the most vital club in the whole school.

TextContext.SourceString: 读书已经够累了，还要来占据我的课后，想·都·不·要·想。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Studying is exhausting enough already. They will not take away my after-school time.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是运营社团也要花时间吧，虽然嘴上这样说，但绯莎还是付出了一些心血？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But doesn't running a club take time, too? Even if you push students to leave, you must've invested some effort, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 因为可以拿到学分，少修一门课。而且，我们不会有任何活动的。除了放学后的自由，大家什么也不会得到。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I earn course credits, letting me skip a subject. Plus, there are no club activities. Members get nothing else, just the freedom to head home.

TextContext.SourceString: （为什么语气这么自豪啊！但我居然有点被说服了……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Why does she sound so proud of herself? But somehow... I feel convinced.)

TextContext.SourceString: （面对着绯莎坚毅的眼神，我的手不自觉伸向了投票箱，为归宅部投下了一票。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Fuchsia's determined gaze meets mine, my hand moves instinctively toward the voting box, casting my vote for the Go-Home Club.)

PrologueTitle.SourceString: 手工制造的梦想，一定会实现

TextContext.SourceString: （就在我沿着林荫道漫步之时，头顶突然传来些许刺痛，有点像走在路上被鸵鸟啄了一下。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I wander down the tree-lined path, a sudden sting hits my head, kind of like getting pecked by an ostrich.)

TextContext.SourceString: 但是校园里怎么会有鸵鸟呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But why would there be an ostrich on campus...)

TextContext.SourceString: （伸手一摸，一架轻盈的小飞机正晃悠悠落在我的掌心。虽然还不到巴掌大，但该少的零部件一个不少，看得出制造者有接近专业的水准。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I reach up and catch a small, lightweight airplane as it wobbles into my palm. It's hardly bigger than my hand, yet brimming with tiny components that scream the handiwork of a near-professional.)

TextContext.SourceString: （然后，这架小飞机居然在没有风的情况下，自己飞起来，又啄了我一口。随后，抖了抖机翼，轻飘飘地飞走了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Then, despite the lack of wind, the tiny airplane takes off again on its own, pecks me once more, flutters its wings, and drifts away.)

TextContext.SourceString: 二段攻击就算了，为什么还有装备掉落啊……上面还有字？
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A second attack? Fine. But why is it dropping loot? Hmm, there's writing on it.)

TextContext.SourceString: “想知道这么神奇的飞机是由谁制造的吗？手工部欢迎你来参观！摊位号S206”……
TextContext.LocalizedString: “Would you like to know who created this amazing airplane? Come visit the Handicraft Club! Booth S206.”

TextContext.SourceString: 好歹毒的宣传方式！必须去看一看了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: (That's one sneaky marketing move! I have to check it out!)

TextContext.SourceString: 所以说，原理就是这样，大家听懂了吗？如果还想再听一遍心夏学姐的讲座，记得半个小时后再来哦~
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's how it works. Did everyone get that? If you want to hear my lecture again, come back in half an hour!

TextContext.SourceString: 听懂了~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Got it!

TextContext.SourceString: 谢谢心夏学姐！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you, Instructor Kokona!

TextContext.SourceString: 心夏学姐的演讲就算听一百次也不会腻的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your lecture never gets old, even if I have to listen to it a hundred times!

TextContext.SourceString: （手工部的摊位门口，似乎是刚结束一场讲座。热情的同学们把身材娇小的主讲人围在中间，叽叽喳喳地提问，言语中难掩激动之情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A lecture just wrapped up at the Handicraft Club. Enthusiastic students swarm around the petite speaker, buzzing with excitement as they fire off questions.)

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然也能看出来，其中混入了几个主讲人的迷妹粉丝……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Though it's clear some are just die-hard fans swooning over the speaker...)

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿，你站好一会儿了，要来棚子里休息下吗？距离下一场讲座还有二十分钟。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey, you over there! You've been standing there for a while. Want to come inside and take a seat? The next lecture starts in twenty minutes.

TextContext.SourceString: 欸？那个，我不是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh? No, I'm not...

TextContext.SourceString: 不是什么？不是学生，还是对手工不感兴趣？没关系嘛，都可以来参观参观。今天展出了不少部员的原创手工设计呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not what? Not a student, or just not into crafts? No worries; everyone’s welcome to explore. We’ve got plenty of original creations from our club on display today.

TextContext.SourceString: 当然，参观完后，要是能投下你的一票就好啦。毕竟我们是个需要支持的冷门社团嘛。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you enjoy the exhibit, we'd appreciate your vote. We're a niche club, after all.

TextContext.SourceString: （面对如此真诚的邀请，我也说不出拒绝的话。抱着试试看的心情走入帐篷内，映入眼帘的一切却令我目不暇接。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I cannot bring myself to refuse the girl's sincere invitation. With a curious mindset, I step into the tent. I'm instantly overwhelmed by everything inside.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这些……都是你们社团的人设计的？这个热能感应警报器、这个医疗无人机，都可以直接投入生产了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is everything designed by members of your club? The thermal-sensing alarm and the medical drone are ready to go straight into production.

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿嘿，在这么多展品里精准挑中了我制造的两个，你眼光很好嘛。不过比起投入生产，能更多地帮到其他人就够了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wow, you managed to spot the two I created out of everything here. You've got a sharp eye. Rather than churning them out for production, I just hope they can really help people.

TextContext.SourceString: 等我考上莱特工学院！哼哼，我一定会发明出更多、更好的东西！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Once I get into the Wright Institute of Technology, I'll invent even more amazing things!

TextContext.SourceString: 到时候，你说不定会在电视或者报纸上看到我哦？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You just might see me on TV or in the news!

TextContext.SourceString: （和心夏度过了一段愉快的时光。在下一场讲座开始之前，我郑重投下了自己的一票。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After a delightful time with Kokona, I cast my vote before the next lecture kicks off.)

TextContext.SourceString: （沿着林荫道走了一会，被正午的阳光晒着，已经有点昏昏欲睡了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After walking along the tree-lined path for a while, the midday sun makes me feel drowsy.)

TextContext.SourceString: （此时，一阵强劲的音乐声响起，如天雷一般直指我的脑门，我瞬间清醒了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Suddenly, a powerful blast of music erupts, like thunder striking right at my forehead. It wakes me up instantly.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——哪来的音乐声？！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Where is this music coming from?!

TextContext.SourceString: （环顾四周，身边的人也都是被吓了一跳的样子。少数几名同学则面露喜色，加快脚步小跑起来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I look around, and everyone else seems just as startled. A few students, however, look excited and pick up their pace, jogging toward the source of the sound.)

TextContext.SourceString: 各位，准备好感受灵魂的震颤了吗！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you ready to feel your soul tremble?!

TextContext.SourceString: 今天的演出是我明姐开场，你们可算是来着了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Today's show kicks off with none other than Ming herself! You're in for a real treat!

TextContext.SourceString: （在喷泉广场附近搭起了一座舞台，似乎是有校园乐队在演出？看起来还挺有气势呢。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (They've set up a stage near the fountain, and it seems like a school band is performing. The vibe is pretty intense.)

TextContext.SourceString: （只是，那个自称“明姐”的吉他手，怎么是一副不良的打扮，这么张扬？还是说这只是个人的服装偏好……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The guitarist who calls herself Ming... Why is she dressed like a delinquent? Is this her style?)

TextContext.SourceString: （但必须承认，明姐的现场演出效果太好了！飞舞的指尖之下，激扬旋律直击人心，欢呼声一浪高过一浪，围观的人也越来越多。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I have to admit—Ming's performance is phenomenal! Her fingers fly across the strings, sending electrifying melodies straight to the heart. Cheers rise wave upon wave, and the crowd just keeps growing.)

TextContext.SourceString: （怎么越来越挤了……再往前我都快走上舞台了！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It's getting too crowded... If I move any further, I'll end up on stage!)

TextContext.SourceString: 哦？看来不只是同学，连市民代表都被我吸引了嘛。来，把你们的欢呼声借给我，让市民代表看看卡丘学园的实力！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh? We’ve caught the eye of not just students but a citizen representative too. Come on, lend me your cheers! Let's show them what Strinova Academy is all about!

TextContext.SourceString: （莫名成为了众人的视觉中心，被震耳欲聋的欢呼声包裹，想挤出人群简直是天方夜谭……我只好尴尬地笑笑，举起手和大家打招呼。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Somehow, I've found myself in the spotlight. Engulfed by deafening cheers, escaping this crowd is a pipe dream... I just awkwardly smile and wave.)

TextContext.SourceString: 击掌吗？没问题！这位新朋友很热情啊，以后还想来看轻音部的演出，直接报明姐的名字就好，欢迎欢迎！
TextContext.LocalizedString: A high-five? You got it! Our new friend here is full of spirit! If you want to catch the Music Club's performance again, just drop Ming's name! You're always welcome!

TextContext.SourceString: 能不能……救救……人太多……我要被推上舞台了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please... help me... It's too crowded... I'm going to be pushed onto the stage...

TextContext.SourceString: 欸？你一直在比划什么，是想上台一起演出吗？没问题！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh? You're gesturing a lot—do you want to join us on stage? No problem!

TextContext.SourceString: （猝不及防地，我被明拽上了舞台。一个话筒被塞进了掌心，我目瞪口呆地看着完全状况外的吉他手。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Before I know it, Ming yanks me onto the stage. A microphone is thrust into my hand, and I stand there, stunned, staring at the totally unfazed guitarist.)

TextContext.SourceString: 愣着干嘛？唱啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: What are you waiting for? Sing!

TextContext.SourceString: 你还好吧？刚刚你被奥黛丽叫走时她表情很差……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you okay? Audrey seemed angry when she called you away just now...

TextContext.SourceString: 没什么大不了，只是又被高高在上的学生会训斥了而已。每个月都要来一次，我都习惯了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's fine. Just another scolding from the almighty student council. It happens once a month. I'm used to it.

TextContext.SourceString: 是吗，你习惯了就好……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Well, I'm glad you're used to it...

TextContext.SourceString: 但！你明明唱得很好啊！如果你一句都唱不了我肯定会给你解围的啊！奥黛丽为什么说我在为难你啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: But you crushed it on stage! I would've jumped in if you couldn't hit a note! Why does Audrey think I was giving you a hard time?!

TextContext.SourceString: 不行，越想越气！我要去找奥黛丽讨个说法，你，跟我一起去，在她面前再表演一次！你不是本来就要去找奥黛丽吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: No way, I’m getting more upset the more I think about it! I'm going to confront Audrey, and you’re coming with me. Let’s give her an encore performance! Weren't you headed to see her anyway?

TextContext.SourceString: 我只是要去说明今天的投票情况……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I was just going to report today's voting results...

TextContext.SourceString: （当然，明姐并不会给我解释的时间，而是一把拽过我，在校园内疾驰。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Unsurprisingly, Ming doesn't give me a chance to explain. She grabs my arm and charges through the campus.)

TextContext.SourceString: （看来，这个过于热闹的开放日不会这么容易结束了……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Looks like this over-the-top open day won’t be wrapping up anytime soon...)
